_provenance: Stimulus playlist for the clip-log format. Family is read from the clip log's ClipName column (filename as fallback) and mapped to these indices via zyldoa/unity.py:FAMILY_STIM_INDEX. `type` drives the DOA band (broadband_noise = 0.4-1.2 kHz; tone = +/-1/6 octave around dominant_hz). The analysis window is taken PER TRIAL from the clip log (ClipEnd - ClipStart, minus 20 ms at each end; pipeline.clip_window); `clip_duration_s` here is only a fallback. NOTE: pink noise is a 200 ms clip in the new recordings too (01_pink_noise.wav, ClipEnd-ClipStart = 0.200 s) -- it previously fell through to the legacy 0.10-0.40 s window and 0.15-0.55 s SNR window, i.e. mostly post-stimulus reverberation.
